description.zh:
任务类型。 取值：
* **SINGLE\_TO\_SHARD**：单表转分表
* **SHARD\_TO\_SINGLE**： 分表转单表
* **SHARD\_TO\_SHARD**：分表转分表
description.en:
The task type. Valid values:
* **SINGLE\_TO\_SHARD**: converts a single table to a sharded table.
* **SHARD\_TO\_SINGLE**: converts a sharded table to a single table.
* **SHARD\_TO\_SHARD**: converts a sharded table to another sharded table.

title.zh: 校验拆分变更任务是否合法
title.en: Check whether a sharding change task is valid

example.unifiedCli: aliyun drds validate-shard-task --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --drds-instance-id drds23ds0000 --db-name test --source-table-name buyer --target-table-name buyer_new --task-type SINGLE_TO_SHARD --api-version 2019-01-23 --region cn-hangzhou
